faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 0 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Texas Senate race sees record early voting, Netflix leadership overhaul, and viral rant.
kurzfassung: Record-breaking early voting is underway in Texas for a tightly contested Senate race between Ken Paxton and James Tallarico, with Elon Musk pouring millions into supporting the Republican candidate. Netflix is restructuring its leadership after facing criticism over programming quality, declining viewer engagement, and drops in subscriber growth. Meanwhile, an Indiana local election candidate defends a controversial, alcohol-fueled television appearance where she launched into an anti-Republican rant.
stichpunkte: Texas early voting hits record highs in the competitive U.S. Senate race between Ken Paxton and James Tallarico.
Elon Musk funnels $158 million into a super PAC supporting Republican candidates in Texas.
Netflix replaces chief content officer Bella Bajaria and film chief Dan Lin amid falling viewing times and subscriber concerns.
The streaming giant shifts focus back to core movie and television production after expanding into games and podcasts.
A ProPublica report reveals the FBI previously investigated bribery allegations linking lawmakers to a convicted defense contractor.
Indiana local council candidate Jamie West admits to drinking three beers before a viral television rant against Republicans.

clips.hook: Texas Senate Polls Show a Dead Heat
clips.text: Recent polling data indicates a statistical tie between the two leading candidates in the Texas Senate contest.

clips.hook: New Leadership for Global Content Budget
clips.text: A veteran Hollywood executive takes charge of managing the streaming platform's massive multi-billion-dollar content spending.
Investor skepticism and growth concerns cause a significant drop in market value over the preceding year.
Federal authorities take a defense contractor into custody on loan fraud charges, leading to a subsequent guilty plea and cooperation agreement.

clips.hook: Admitting to Three Beers Before Interview
clips.text: A local political candidate progressively increases her admission of how many alcoholic drinks she consumed prior to a disastrous television appearance.

beschreibung:
Record-breaking early voting in Texas comes as Republican Ken Paxton and Democrat James Talarico remain locked in a tight Senate race, with Democrats hoping to win their first statewide election in decades. Netflix overhauls its leadership amid declining viewer engagement, criticism of its programming, and disappointing financial forecasts. A new ProPublica investigation reveals how the FBI pursued bribery allegations involving Lindsey Graham, James Clyburn, and Joe Wilson after claims from a person convicted of fraud. Indiana Democrat Jaime West admits to drinking three beers before a viral television interview in which she attacked Republicans, and says she has no regrets about her remarks during an interview with Piers Morgan.
